name: team_monitor
description: Team cycle (roadmap Phase 3, §4.5): the monitor role. Watches the board each wave with bounded authority — applies small corrections autonomously (nudge a thrashing item, re-prioritize it) and escalates anything bigger (a blocked item, duplication, a budget breach) to the exception queue for a human to drive. Its primary output is the human rollup + the open-exception count (H7). Never kills work, expands scope, or spends on its own.

ceilingUsd.description: Run spend ceiling; a breach is escalated.

stallAttempts.description: Attempts at which an open item counts as a stall (autonomous nudge).

qualityChanges.description: Peer-review changes rounds at which an item counts as a quality regression.

dispatchedCount.description: How many items this wave's standup dispatched; 0 with scopeWaits and nothing in flight means the next wave is this wave again (starved: scope_wait).

scopeWaits.description: The standup's held items ('<item> waits for <owner> to land <path>'), each posted as a scope_wait escalation when the run is starved on them.

openExceptions.description: Open escalations needing a human decision.
